# Security audit (cms-api)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`access-admin`](../../flows/access-admin/FLOW.md), [`backups`](../../flows/backups/FLOW.md), [`media`](../../flows/media/FLOW.md), [`owner-setup`](../../flows/owner-setup/FLOW.md), [`password`](../../flows/password/FLOW.md), [`reviewer`](../../flows/reviewer/FLOW.md), [`security-audit`](../../flows/security-audit/FLOW.md), [`sign-in`](../../flows/sign-in/FLOW.md), [`two-factor-setup`](../../flows/two-factor-setup/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

The one writer of the security audit log: every security action (login success/failure, two-factor, password, roles, API tokens, owner setup, reviewer) is recorded with actor, action and metadata (SPEC §7 D15).

## Techniques

Port + adapter: `SecurityAuditService` writes through `AuditLogWriter` inside the caller's transaction (`TransactionRunner`). Action names and reason enums are constants. CLIs build the service by hand (no Nest).

## Technologies

NestJS 11, Prisma 7.

## Entry points

`SecurityAuditService` (exported from `index.ts`); used by identity, access, reviewer and the CLIs.

## Where to change what

A new audited action: add it to `AUDIT_ACTIONS` (and a reason enum if needed) in `domain/SecurityAudit.constants.ts`, call `SecurityAuditService` from the use case. Never write audit rows elsewhere.
